items.title: Nonviral, ultrasound-triggered gene delivery platform via gas-core cationic nanobubbles
items.abstract_or_text: Despite their promise, lipid nanoparticle gene delivery systems have repeatedly failed clinical trials and struggle to achieve efficient, localized transfection in target tissues. The majority of endocytosed nanoparticles are degraded before nucleic acid release, and an inability to track particle distribution in vivo prevents validation of successful delivery. Alternatively, nanobubbles (NBs) are lipid-shelled, gas-core preclinical ultrasound contrast agents and stimuli-responsive drug delivery vehicles. Under varying acoustic pressures, NBs expand, contract, and burst, releasing cargo in an externally controlled, site-specific manner while scattering unique echoes for simultaneous ultrasound visualization. Here, we introduce a cationic nanobubble (CNB) formulation with a +42.3 mV zeta potential, 265 nm diameter, and 2.43×10 11 NBs/mL concentration. CNBs produce stable ultrasound contrast, electrostatically load plasmid DNA onto their surface, and internalize into >99% of human prostate cancer cells within 15 minutes in vitro . CNBs remain brightly echogenic intracellularly and induce sonication-dependent expression of green fluorescent protein (GFP). In vivo , CNBs generate contrast in mouse livers for 50 minutes after intravenous administration. Therapeutic ultrasound stimulation over the liver causes a sharp reduction in ultrasound contrast, visualizing localized cavitation in the target organ and inducing a 2.5-fold increase in anti-GFP mean fluorescence intensity relative to the untransfected control. Importantly, no GFP expression is observed without ultrasound stimulation, supporting a mechanism for selective and site-specific gene delivery. This study presents a highly stable CNB capable of efficient DNA loading and ultrasound-dependent gene expression. These results provide a foundation for the future development of CNB platforms to advance image-guided, ultrasound-triggered gene therapy.
items.summary_zh: 气核阳离子纳米气泡在体外高效内化并负载质粒 DNA；在小鼠肝脏中，超声触发后出现局部 GFP 表达及可同步监测的造影变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将可视化、局部声学触发与非病毒基因递送整合到同一平台，并提供了细胞和小鼠证据；但其转化价值仍需在更大动物模型和临床研究中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管前景可观，脂质纳米颗粒基因递送系统已多次在临床试验中失败，并且难以在靶组织中实现高效、局部的转染。多数被内吞的纳米颗粒会在核酸释放前被降解，而无法在体内追踪颗粒分布，使得成功递送难以验证。另一种选择是纳米气泡（NBs）：它们是脂质包壳、气核的临床前超声造影剂和刺激响应型药物递送载体。在不同声压下，NBs 会膨胀、收缩和破裂，以可由外部控制的、位点特异性的方式释放载荷，同时散射独特回波以实现同步超声可视化。本文介绍了一种阳离子纳米气泡（CNB）配方，其 ζ 电位为 +42.3 mV、直径为 265 nm、浓度为 2.43×10 11 NBs/mL。CNBs 产生稳定的超声对比度，通过静电作用将质粒 DNA 负载于表面，并在体外 15 分钟内进入超过 99% 的人前列腺癌细胞。CNBs 在细胞内仍保持明亮的回声性，并诱导依赖声波照射的绿色荧光蛋白（GFP）表达。在体内，静脉给药后 CNBs 可在小鼠肝脏中产生持续 50 分钟的对比度。对肝脏施加治疗性超声会导致超声对比度急剧下降，从而可视化靶器官内局部空化，并使抗 GFP 平均荧光强度相对于未转染对照增加 2.5 倍。重要的是，未进行超声刺激时未观察到 GFP 表达，这支持一种选择性、位点特异性基因递送机制。本研究提出了一种高度稳定的 CNB，能够高效负载 DNA 并实现依赖超声的基因表达。这些结果为未来开发 CNB 平台、推进图像引导的超声触发基因治疗奠定了基础。

items.title: TransBind2: Improving Transcription Factor-DNA Binding Prediction with Multimodal Data and Bidirectional Cross Attention
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate genome-wide prediction of transcription factor (TF)-DNA binding remains challenging because many models focus mainly on DNA sequence and overlook chromatin context and TF structure. We previously developed TransBind, a protein-aware model that combines TF and DNA representations through cross-attention. Here, we introduce TransBind2, which improves on TransBind in several ways. It incorporates DNase-seq accessibility and genome mappability tracks as additional input, uses a biomodal protein language model (ProstT5) to capture both TF sequence and structure, and applies bidirectional cross-attention so DNA and protein features can refine each other. We also frame prediction as binary classification of individual triplets, allowing the model to generalize to new TFs and cell types. Across 690 human ChIP-seq experiments covering 161 TFs and 91 cell types, TransBind2 achieves a macro AUROC of 0.9648 and AUPR of 0.4215, outperforming TransBind and other baselines, with a ≥12.67% relative AUPR gain. The model trained on human data also performs well in cross-species zero-shot prediction on mouse data. Saliency analysis shows that it can identify TF-binding peaks with a median error of 12-38 base pairs (bps) despite being trained on window-level labels. Ablation studies further show that TF structure, chromatin accessibility, and bidirectional attention each improve performance. Overall, these results show that combining TF structure with chromatin context leads to more accurate and generalizable TF-DNA binding predictions.
items.summary_zh: TransBind2 以 DNA 序列、DNase-seq 可及性、基因组可比对性和 ProstT5 的 TF 序列—结构表示为输入，在 690 个 ChIP-seq 实验、161 个 TF 和 91 种细胞类型上报告宏平均 AUROC 0.9648。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型将蛋白结构和染色质语境纳入 TF-DNA 结合预测，并提供消融与跨物种零样本评估；其性能结论目前仍来自预印本中的计算基准。
items.abstract_zh: 准确的全基因组转录因子（TF）-DNA 结合预测仍具挑战性，因为许多模型主要关注 DNA 序列，而忽略染色质语境和 TF 结构。我们此前开发了 TransBind，这是一种通过交叉注意力结合 TF 和 DNA 表示的蛋白质感知模型。本文介绍 TransBind2，其在多个方面改进了 TransBind。它将 DNase-seq 可及性和基因组可比对性轨道作为附加输入，使用双模态蛋白质语言模型（ProstT5）同时捕获 TF 序列和结构，并应用双向交叉注意力，使 DNA 和蛋白质特征能够彼此细化。我们还将预测表述为单个三元组的二分类任务，使模型可泛化至新的 TF 和细胞类型。在覆盖 161 个 TF 和 91 种细胞类型的 690 个人人类 ChIP-seq 实验中，TransBind2 达到 0.9648 的宏平均 AUROC 和 0.4215 的 AUPR，优于 TransBind 和其他基线，AUPR 相对提升至少 12.67%。在小鼠数据上，该模型在由人类数据训练后的跨物种零样本预测中也表现良好。显著性分析表明，尽管模型以窗口级标签训练，它仍能以 12-38 个碱基对（bps）的中位误差识别 TF 结合峰。消融研究进一步表明，TF 结构、染色质可及性和双向注意力各自均能提升性能。总体而言，这些结果表明，将 TF 结构与染色质语境结合可带来更准确且更具泛化性的 TF-DNA 结合预测。

items.title: Diagnostic Performance of Agentic AI for Rare Disease Diagnosis: A Systematic Review, Meta-analysis, Workflow Development, and Benchmark-based Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Rare diseases are characterized by diverse disease entities, heterogeneous phenotypes, complex diagnostic processes, and reliance on specialized expertise, resulting in substantial diagnostic delays. Large language models (LLMs) and Agentic artificial intelligence (Agentic AI) have recently been introduced into medical diagnosis. Compared with standalone LLMs, Agentic AI incorporates planning, external knowledge retrieval, iterative reasoning, and feedback mechanisms to improve complex diagnostic tasks. However, the overall diagnostic performance of Agentic AI in rare disease diagnosis and its transferable core workflows remain unclear. Methods A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted using PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, arXiv, and medRxiv/bioRxiv. Studies applying Agentic AI for rare disease diagnosis with extractable Top-1 diagnostic accuracy were included. Recall@1 was synthesized using a random effects single arm meta analysis, with leave-one-out sensitivity analysis. Agent capabilities were standardized using a unified capability taxonomy derived from existing agent frameworks. A lightweight workflow was subsequently constructed based on recurrently reported capabilities and evaluated using 50 randomly selected RareBench cases. The workflow-assisted Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) model was compared with the same model operating in standalone mode using Recall@1, Recall@3, and Recall@5. Results Seven studies contributing 19 effect estimates and 33,738 cases were included. The pooled Recall@1 was 51.2% (95% confidence interval [CI], 45.3% − 57.1%), and substantial heterogeneity was observed (I 2 = 98.5%). Leave-one-out analysis demonstrated robustness of the pooled estimate. Capability synthesis identified reasoning and hypothesis refinement and planning and task decomposition as the most consistently reported capabilities (7/7), followed by tool use and external knowledge integration and traceability and explainability (6/7). In RareBench validation, the workflow-assisted model improved Top-1 diagnosis compared with standalone GPT, achieving 11/50 correct diagnoses versus 5/50. Case level comparison showed that the workflow corrected 7 baseline errors, whereas baseline performance was superior in 1 case (exact McNemar test, P = 0.0703). Conclusions Agentic AI has demonstrated a certain level of diagnostic performance in rare disease diagnosis. However, diagnostic performance varies across different agent systems. In this study, we integrated the workflows reported in the included studies. The resulting workflow incorporates structured reasoning, external knowledge retrieval, and evidence tracking. This approach may provide a reproducible method for improving large language model based diagnostic systems. Future studies should develop more comprehensive workflows and conduct larger scale external validation. Ablation studies are also needed to determine the specific contribution of each agentic capability.
items.summary_zh: 该系统综述与单臂随机效应 Meta 分析纳入 7 项研究、19 个效应量和 33,738 个病例；其 50 例 RareBench 验证中，工作流辅助 GPT 的 Top-1 正确数为 11/50，独立 GPT 为 5/50。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把罕见病诊断 Agent 的能力要素、汇总性能和可复现工作流放在同一框架中；但合并 Recall@1 的异质性极高，且小型基准比较未达常规显著性阈值。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 罕见病具有疾病实体多样、表型异质、诊断流程复杂并依赖专门知识等特点，导致显著的诊断延迟。大语言模型（LLMs）和 Agentic artificial intelligence（Agentic AI）近期已被引入医学诊断。与独立 LLM 相比，Agentic AI 融入规划、外部知识检索、迭代推理和反馈机制，以改进复杂诊断任务。然而，Agentic AI 在罕见病诊断中的总体诊断性能及其可迁移的核心工作流尚不明确。方法 使用 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、arXiv 和 medRxiv/bioRxiv 开展系统综述和 Meta 分析。纳入应用 Agentic AI 进行罕见病诊断且可提取 Top-1 诊断准确率的研究。采用随机效应单臂 Meta 分析汇总 Recall@1，并进行逐一剔除敏感性分析。使用从现有 Agent 框架导出的统一能力分类法对 Agent 能力进行标准化。随后基于反复报告的能力构建轻量级工作流，并使用随机选取的 50 个 RareBench 病例进行评估。使用 Recall@1、Recall@3 和 Recall@5，将工作流辅助的 Generative Pre-trained Transformer（GPT）模型与以独立模式运行的同一模型进行比较。结果 纳入了 7 项研究，贡献 19 个效应量和 33,738 个病例。合并 Recall@1 为 51.2%（95% 置信区间 [CI]，45.3% − 57.1%），并观察到显著异质性（I 2 = 98.5%）。逐一剔除分析显示合并估计具有稳健性。能力综合显示，推理与假设细化、规划与任务分解是报告最一致的能力（7/7），其次是工具使用与外部知识整合、可追溯性与可解释性（6/7）。在 RareBench 验证中，工作流辅助模型相较独立 GPT 改善了 Top-1 诊断，达到 11/50 个正确诊断，而独立 GPT 为 5/50。病例级比较显示，该工作流纠正了 7 个基线错误，而基线在 1 个病例中表现更好（精确 McNemar 检验，P = 0.0703）。结论 Agentic AI 已在罕见病诊断中显示出一定水平的诊断性能。然而，不同 Agent 系统之间的诊断性能存在差异。本研究整合了纳入研究中报告的工作流。所得工作流纳入结构化推理、外部知识检索和证据追踪。这一方法可能为改进基于大语言模型的诊断系统提供可复现的方法。未来研究应开发更全面的工作流，并开展更大规模的外部验证。还需要消融研究来确定每项 Agent 能力的具体贡献。
items.author_line: Zheng C, Zhu J, Hu X, Wang C, Chen L

items.title: An Interpretable Machine Learning Framework for Predicting In-Hospital Mortality in Patients with Heart Failure and Concurrent Infection: Development Using MIMIC-IV and External Validation in eICU-CRD
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Patients with heart failure and concurrent infection are at increased risk of adverse in-hospital outcomes because cardiac dysfunction, systemic inflammation, organ impairment, and acute physiological deterioration may occur simultaneously. This study aimed to develop and externally evaluate machine learning models for predicting in-hospital mortality in this high-risk population and to characterize model predictions using SHAP analysis. Methods Adults with heart failure and concurrent infection were identified from the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV (MIMIC-IV) database and the eICU Collaborative Research Database (eICU-CRD). A total of 1,415 patients from MIMIC-IV were used for model development and internal evaluation, while 2,826 patients from eICU-CRD were used for external validation. Patients were classified as survivors or non-survivors according to their in-hospital discharge status. Four machine learning models—logistic regression, AdaBoost, XGBoost, and LightGBM—were developed and evaluated. Model performance was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, accuracy, precision, and F1-score. Performance was further examined in bacterial-infection and non-bacterial-infection subgroups. SHAP analysis was applied to the XGBoost model to characterize the contribution of individual features to model predictions. Results In the MIMIC-IV internal test set, LightGBM achieved the highest observed AUC in the overall cohort and the bacterial-infection subgroup, with AUCs of 0.836 and 0.818, respectively. XGBoost achieved the highest observed AUC in the non-bacterial-infection subgroup, with an AUC of 0.846. In the eICU-CRD external validation cohort, AdaBoost achieved the highest observed AUC in the bacterial-infection subgroup, with an AUC of 0.746, whereas XGBoost achieved the highest observed AUC in the non-bacterial-infection subgroup, with an AUC of 0.725. Thus, model discrimination varied across databases and infection subgroups, and no single algorithm demonstrated consistently superior performance across all evaluation cohorts. SHAP analysis identified the Glasgow Coma Scale score, white blood cell count, blood urea nitrogen, body weight, and urine output among the influential features contributing to the XGBoost predictions. Conclusions The performance of the evaluated machine learning models varied across databases and infection subgroups. SHAP analysis provided model-level explanations of the XGBoost predictions but should not be interpreted as evidence of causal relationships or independent risk factors. These findings support the potential value of interpretable machine learning as an exploratory framework for risk stratification in patients with heart failure and concurrent infection. Prospective multicentre validation, calibration assessment, and evaluation of clinical utility are required before clinical implementation.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 MIMIC-IV 的 1,415 名心力衰竭合并感染患者建模，并以 eICU-CRD 的 2,826 名患者外部验证；外部队列中最高 AUC 为细菌感染亚组 0.746、非细菌感染亚组 0.725。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究明确呈现了跨数据库和感染亚组的性能下降及不稳定性，并避免把 SHAP 归因解读为风险因素或因果证据；临床实施仍需前瞻性多中心验证、校准和效用评估。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 心力衰竭合并感染的患者因心功能障碍、全身炎症、器官损害和急性生理恶化可能同时发生，住院期间不良结局风险增加。本研究旨在开发并外部评估用于预测这一高风险人群院内死亡的机器学习模型，并使用 SHAP 分析表征模型预测。方法 从 Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV（MIMIC-IV）数据库和 eICU Collaborative Research Database（eICU-CRD）中识别心力衰竭合并感染的成年患者。来自 MIMIC-IV 的共 1,415 名患者用于模型开发和内部评估，来自 eICU-CRD 的 2,826 名患者用于外部验证。依据住院出院状态将患者分为存活者或非存活者。开发并评估了四种机器学习模型——逻辑回归、AdaBoost、XGBoost 和 LightGBM。使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积、准确率、精确率和 F1 分数评估模型性能。还在细菌感染和非细菌感染亚组中考察性能。对 XGBoost 模型应用 SHAP 分析，以表征各特征对模型预测的贡献。结果 在 MIMIC-IV 内部测试集中，LightGBM 在总体队列和细菌感染亚组中取得最高观察到的 AUC，分别为 0.836 和 0.818。XGBoost 在非细菌感染亚组中取得最高观察到的 AUC，为 0.846。在 eICU-CRD 外部验证队列中，AdaBoost 在细菌感染亚组中取得最高观察到的 AUC，为 0.746；而 XGBoost 在非细菌感染亚组中取得最高观察到的 AUC，为 0.725。因此，模型区分度在数据库和感染亚组之间存在差异，没有单一算法在所有评估队列中持续表现更优。SHAP 分析将 Glasgow Coma Scale 评分、白细胞计数、血尿素氮、体重和尿量识别为对 XGBoost 预测有影响的特征。结论 所评估的机器学习模型性能在数据库和感染亚组间存在差异。SHAP 分析为 XGBoost 预测提供了模型层面的解释，但不应被解读为因果关系或独立危险因素的证据。这些发现支持可解释机器学习作为心力衰竭合并感染患者风险分层探索性框架的潜在价值。在临床实施前，需要进行前瞻性多中心验证、校准评估和临床效用评价。
items.author_line: Zhang X, Liu C, Guang X, Gao G, Fan H, Zhang H, Zhou Q, Diao X, Lu W

items.title: Development and External Validation of a Machine Learning–Based Clinical Prediction Model for Postoperative Ischemic Stroke in Patients Undergoing Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: Validation Using the eICU Collaborative Research Database
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Postoperative ischemic stroke is a serious complication following coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) and is associated with substantial adverse clinical consequences. Existing risk scores have limited discriminatory ability for predicting postoperative ischemic stroke, whereas previously developed machine learning models have predominantly been derived from single-center cohorts and often lack adequate independent external validation. This study aimed to develop and externally validate a machine learning model for predicting ischemic stroke after CABG. Methods This retrospective study included 938 patients who underwent CABG at Beijing Anzhen Hospital, Capital Medical University, between 2019 and 2021 as the model development cohort. An independent cohort of 1,177 patients derived from the eICU Collaborative Research Database was used for external validation.Feature selection was first performed using the Boruta algorithm, followed by univariable ROC analysis of the Boruta-confirmed variables; the seven variables with the highest discriminatory performance were retained as the final feature set. Five machine learning models were subsequently developed. Model performance was comprehensively evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves, precision-recall (PR) curves, calibration curves, and decision curve analysis (DCA). SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis was further performed to interpret the predictions of the best-performing model and quantify the relative contribution of individual predictors. Results: Among the five machine learning algorithms evaluated, the random forest (RF) model demonstrated the best overall predictive performance. The RF model achieved a mean AUC of 0.934 in 10-fold cross-validation and an AUC of 0.764 (95% CI, 0.703–0.826) in the external eICU validation cohort. SHAP analysis identified red blood cell distribution width–coefficient of variation (RDW-CV), arterial oxygen content (CaO₂), systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), hematocrit (HCT), body surface area (BSA), estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), and a history of ischemic stroke as the most influential predictors of postoperative ischemic stroke. Conclusions: The RF model developed in this study demonstrated good discriminatory performance for predicting ischemic stroke after CABG and maintained moderate predictive performance in an independent external eICU cohort. This model may serve as an early risk-stratification tool to facilitate the identification of patients at high risk of postoperative ischemic stroke and support individualized perioperative monitoring and preventive strategies.
items.summary_zh: 该回顾性研究在 938 名 CABG 患者中开发模型，并在 eICU 的 1,177 名独立患者中验证；随机森林模型内部交叉验证 AUC 为 0.934，外部 AUC 为 0.764。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 独立数据库验证比单中心内部评估更接近可迁移性检验，但外部性能明显下降，且预测变量的 SHAP 重要性不构成致病或可干预因素证据。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）后缺血性卒中是一种严重并发症，并与显著不良临床后果相关。现有风险评分预测术后缺血性卒中的区分能力有限，而此前开发的机器学习模型主要源于单中心队列，且常缺乏充分的独立外部验证。本研究旨在开发并外部验证一项用于预测 CABG 后缺血性卒中的机器学习模型。方法 这项回顾性研究纳入 2019 至 2021 年间于首都医科大学附属北京安贞医院接受 CABG 的 938 名患者，作为模型开发队列。使用源自 eICU Collaborative Research Database 的 1,177 名患者组成独立队列进行外部验证。首先使用 Boruta 算法进行特征选择，随后对经 Boruta 确认的变量进行单变量 ROC 分析；保留具有最高区分性能的 7 个变量作为最终特征集。随后开发五种机器学习模型。通过受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线、精确率—召回率（PR）曲线、校准曲线和决策曲线分析（DCA）全面评估模型性能。进一步进行 SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）分析，以解释性能最佳模型的预测，并量化各预测因子的相对贡献。结果 在评估的五种机器学习算法中，随机森林（RF）模型显示出最佳总体预测性能。RF 模型在 10 折交叉验证中达到平均 AUC 0.934，在外部 eICU 验证队列中达到 AUC 0.764（95% CI，0.703–0.826）。SHAP 分析将红细胞分布宽度—变异系数（RDW-CV）、动脉血氧含量（CaO₂）、系统免疫炎症指数（SII）、血细胞比容（HCT）、体表面积（BSA）、估算肾小球滤过率（eGFR）和缺血性卒中病史识别为对术后缺血性卒中最有影响的预测因子。结论 本研究开发的 RF 模型在预测 CABG 后缺血性卒中时表现出良好的区分性能，并在独立外部 eICU 队列中保持中等预测性能。该模型可作为早期风险分层工具，以促进识别术后缺血性卒中高风险患者，并支持个体化围手术期监测和预防策略。
items.author_line: Chen S, Zhao Y, Zhao S, Wen M, Hu Y, Mei J, wen Q, Song H, Gong M

items.title: Single-cell transcriptomic and epigenomic analysis reveals X-linked sex differences in aging mouse hypothalamus
items.abstract_or_text: Sex differences contribute to brain aging, neurodegenerative diseases, and more broadly in determining rates of aging across species. The hypothalamus plays a central role in physiological homeostasis and healthy aging, yet how its cellular and molecular landscape diverges between males and females over the lifespan remains poorly understood. Here, we present a single-nucleus multi-omics analysis of the hypothalamus in young, middle aged, and aged male and female mice. We identified major hypothalamic cell types and characterized their sex- and age-dependent transcriptional and chromatin accessibility profiles. Notably, female-specific changes on the X chromosome (chrX) emerged as a prominent feature of aging, including changes to the X inactivation center and an overall increase in chrX gene expression and accessibility in immune cells and neurons. Pseudotime analysis of immune cells revealed an aging trajectory with sex-specific multi-omic programs, featuring increased inflammation in females compared to males. Delving deeper into the epigenetic signatures associated with these sex differences, we found that H3K27me3 - the repressive histone mark enriched on the inactive X in females - increased in abundance and underwent substantial genome-wide redistribution with age in both sexes, particularly on the inactive chrX in females. Collectively, these findings highlight distinct cell-type-specific aging trajectories in the male and female hypothalamus, identify female aging signatures associated with X-linked epigenetic regulatory programs, and provide a comprehensive resource for understanding the molecular basis of sex differences in brain aging.
items.summary_zh: 研究对青年、中年和老年雌雄小鼠下丘脑进行单核多组学分析，发现随年龄出现的雌性 chrX 特异性表达和开放性改变，以及具有性别差异的免疫细胞衰老轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把转录组、染色质可及性和 H3K27me3 的年龄相关重分布连到细胞类型分辨率的性别差异，为脑衰老机制研究提供资源；结果来自小鼠，不能直接外推至人类疾病。
items.abstract_zh: 性别差异会影响脑衰老、神经退行性疾病，并更广泛地决定跨物种的衰老速率。下丘脑在生理稳态和健康衰老中发挥核心作用，但在整个生命周期中，其细胞和分子图谱如何在雄性和雌性之间分化仍知之甚少。本文对青年、中年和老年雄性及雌性小鼠的下丘脑进行了单核多组学分析。我们鉴定出主要下丘脑细胞类型，并表征了其依赖性别和年龄的转录及染色质可及性图谱。值得注意的是，X 染色体（chrX）上的雌性特异性变化成为衰老的突出特征，包括 X 失活中心的变化，以及免疫细胞和神经元中 chrX 基因表达和可及性的总体升高。免疫细胞的拟时序分析揭示了一条具有性别特异性多组学程序的衰老轨迹，其中雌性的炎症增加程度高于雄性。进一步深入分析与这些性别差异相关的表观遗传特征后，我们发现 H3K27me3——在雌性失活 X 染色体上富集的抑制性组蛋白标记——在两种性别中均随年龄增加丰度，并发生显著的全基因组重分布，尤其是在雌性的失活 chrX 上。总体而言，这些发现突出了雄性和雌性下丘脑中不同的细胞类型特异性衰老轨迹，鉴定出与 X 连锁表观遗传调控程序相关的雌性衰老特征，并为理解脑衰老中性别差异的分子基础提供了综合资源。
items.author_line: Yu D, Osipov I, Hassell L, Shwartz NA, Hajdarovic KH, Marin H, Webb AE

items.title: The protein and lipid compositions of brain apolipoprotein E particles are cell type-specific
items.abstract_or_text: Genetic variation in APOE, which encodes a lipid transporter apolipoprotein E (apoE), is the strongest risk factor for late-onset Alzheimer's disease (AD). Although central nervous system (CNS) apoE is produced by various cell types, including astrocytes, microglia, and pericytes, it is unclear whether apoE lipoproteins are a homogeneous population or if their molecular composition varies depending on their cellular origin. Emerging evidence suggests that CNS apoE lipoproteins contribute to AD-related processes, including amyloid deposition, neuroinflammation, synaptic maintenance, and blood-brain barrier function in a cell type-specific manner. We hypothesized that the compositions of CNS apoE lipoproteins depend on their cellular origin and investigated the lipid and protein profiles of apoE particles secreted by induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived brain cells and derived from human cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). Our results demonstrate that astrocytes, pericytes, and microglia secrete apoE lipoproteins with distinct, cell type-specific lipid and protein profiles. Astrocyte-secreted particles were enriched in sphingomyelins and proteins linked to lipid metabolism, whereas pericyte-secreted particles contained ether-linked phospholipids and proteins associated with antioxidant activity. The lipidation of microglial apoE was markedly lower, but these particles had higher levels of transferrin, apoC-II, and cathepsin D. Notably, one-third of identified features were cell type-specific, highlighting the substantial molecular specialization across cell types. Most lipids and proteins identified in cell-secreted apoE were also detected in CSF-derived particles. Our findings advance the understanding of apoE biology by shifting the focus from apoE as a single, homogeneous entity to a diverse population of complex particles, the composition of which might be linked to functions in health and neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 iPSC 来源星形胶质细胞、周细胞和小胶质细胞及人脑脊液样本为材料，利用 LC-MS/MS 显示 apoE 颗粒的脂质和蛋白组成具有明显细胞类型特异性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该结果细化了 APOE/apoE 作为阿尔茨海默病风险相关分子的细胞来源异质性；它描述的是分子组成和潜在功能联系，尚未证明这些颗粒差异导致疾病过程。
items.abstract_zh: 编码脂质转运蛋白载脂蛋白 E（apoE）的 APOE 遗传变异，是晚发性阿尔茨海默病（AD）最强的风险因素。尽管中枢神经系统（CNS）中的 apoE 由包括星形胶质细胞、小胶质细胞和周细胞在内的多种细胞类型产生，但尚不清楚 apoE 脂蛋白是否为同质群体，或其分子组成是否随细胞来源而变化。新近证据提示，CNS apoE 脂蛋白以细胞类型特异性的方式参与 AD 相关过程，包括淀粉样蛋白沉积、神经炎症、突触维持和血脑屏障功能。我们假设 CNS apoE 脂蛋白的组成取决于其细胞来源，并利用液相色谱—质谱（LC-MS/MS）研究了由诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源脑细胞分泌的 apoE 颗粒以及从人脑脊液（CSF）中获得的 apoE 颗粒的脂质和蛋白图谱。结果表明，星形胶质细胞、周细胞和小胶质细胞分泌的 apoE 脂蛋白具有不同的、细胞类型特异性的脂质和蛋白图谱。星形胶质细胞分泌的颗粒富含鞘磷脂和与脂质代谢相关的蛋白；周细胞分泌的颗粒含有醚键磷脂和与抗氧化活性相关的蛋白。小胶质细胞 apoE 的脂化程度显著较低，但这些颗粒具有更高水平的转铁蛋白、apoC-II 和组织蛋白酶 D。值得注意的是，三分之一已鉴定特征具有细胞类型特异性，突出了跨细胞类型的显著分子特化。细胞分泌 apoE 中鉴定出的绝大多数脂质和蛋白也在 CSF 来源颗粒中检出。我们的发现通过将关注点从 apoE 作为单一同质实体转向一类多样化的复杂颗粒，推进了对 apoE 生物学的理解；这些颗粒的组成可能与健康和神经退行性疾病中的功能有关。
items.author_line: Voloviceva E, Goetze S, Hausler S, Abukar SH, Jagels A, Othman A, von Eckardstein A, Robert J

items.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Protein Language Models Reveals Encoded Structural and Functional Properties of Intrinsically Disordered Proteins
items.abstract_or_text: Protein language models (PLMs) such as ESM-2 encode protein sequences as embeddings for downstream tasks. PLMs are trained on a masked learning objective that leverages evolutionary constraints. While interpretability studies of ESM-2 have focused on folded proteins, their behavior on intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs), which constitute a substantial fraction of the human proteome and are implicated in numerous diseases, remains understudied. Because IDPs experience different types of evolutionary constraints on their amino acid sequences, we hypothesized that PLMs would behave differently on disordered versus folded regions. Here we show that ESM-2 exhibits reduced attention on disordered regions, yet still encodes meaningful biological signals. The model assigns heightened attention to disease-relevant residues even at high levels of disorder. Moreover, we show that both the radius of gyration and individual dynamic contact maps, key characteristics of IDPs, can be obtained from the model logits and embeddings. These findings suggest PLMs capture valuable information relevant to IDP biology despite their bias toward structured residues.
items.summary_zh: 研究指出 ESM-2 虽对无序区的注意力较低，仍可编码与疾病相关残基、回转半径和动态接触图有关的信息，从而扩展了蛋白质语言模型的可解释性范围。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 内在无序蛋白在人体蛋白质组和疾病中广泛存在；该工作为从 PLM 表示中读取其结构—功能信号提供了可检验假设，但未取代实验结构或动力学测量。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）如 ESM-2 将蛋白质序列编码为可用于下游任务的嵌入。PLMs 以利用进化约束的掩码学习目标进行训练。尽管针对 ESM-2 的可解释性研究聚焦于折叠蛋白，但对于构成人类蛋白质组相当大比例、并与多种疾病相关的内在无序蛋白（IDPs），其行为仍研究不足。由于 IDPs 的氨基酸序列经历不同类型的进化约束，我们假设 PLMs 在无序区域与折叠区域上的行为不同。本文显示，ESM-2 对无序区域的注意力降低，但仍编码了有意义的生物学信号。即使在高度无序条件下，该模型也会对疾病相关残基赋予更高注意力。此外，我们显示，IDPs 的关键特征——回转半径和单个动态接触图——均可从模型 logits 和嵌入中获得。这些发现表明，尽管 PLMs 偏向结构化残基，它们仍捕获了与 IDP 生物学相关的有价值信息。
items.author_line: Naworski LE, Good LL, Scrutton R, Knowles TP
